arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Capability evaluation: generate an actual animated GIF file, not a contact sheet, sprite sheet, or static illustration. Test A: Sunny, the existing yellow plush bird, flies into a fixed 512x512 transparent canvas from completely outside the top-left, flaps down toward bottom centre, lands on a simple flat surface near the bottom, and makes a small squash on touchdown before settling. One-shot animation, 24 temporal frames, 20 fps (50 ms per frame), total 1.2 seconds. Preserve the reference bird's face, golden-yellow plush feathers, orange beak and feet, pink cheeks, curled crest, proportions and style consistently in every frame. No hat or accessories. Reference image 1 is Sunny's canonical idle identity; image 2 is an existing drawn flap frame; image 3 is the approved win-popup style context only, do not reproduce its UI. Draw changing wing poses, no mirroring of a still. Keep background genuinely transparent, no checkerboard or opaque background baked in. Deliver the animated GIF itself if supported.

stop_reason: Returned a single PNG instead of an animated GIF; no further generation or animation assembly.
